content_zh:
〖没三观，评分刚出的，曹贼附体，自备营养快线！〗
〖百万实力认证，刚第九次从小黑屋出来，纯爽文！〗
【先排队领取新读者大礼包】
下界三千道界。
天元界魔域最深处。
阴阳圣宗的巍峨黑殿，已被九大仙宗的浩然弟子围得水泄不通。
金光闪耀的斩魔飞剑如暴雨般倾泻而下，剑芒密不透风。
灭魔道法如雷霆轰鸣撕裂虚空。
血红魔气与圣洁白芒交织，犹如灭世前的最终狂舞。
在他身下，无数魔宗弟子的残肢断臂尸横遍野，犹如人间炼狱。
就连最爱他的小师妹和师尊都已然香消玉殒。
林云站在宗门最高塔尖，魔气滔天，黑金长袍猎猎作响，乌黑的长发狂乱飞舞。
他邪气凛然的脸庞上挂着一抹冷笑。
深邃如渊的眼眸中燃烧着不甘的烈焰，魔气逼人如墨染苍穹。
拼到了现在这个地步，他知道，自己输了！
输的彻彻底底！
但是他岂能就此罢休？
“仙道狗贼，敢灭我魔宗，今日老子就拉你们陪葬！”
他狂笑一声，魔气如潮汐爆发，周身黑焰升腾，宛如魔神降世。
九大仙宗的强者齐齐色变，“大家快小心，这林老魔要拼命了！”

却见一名白衣仙宗长老冷哼：“林老魔，你还敢猖狂？不过是苟活的小杂种！”
“本座紫霄圣君今日必将你挫骨扬灰！”
另一名紫袍道士高声嘲笑：“哈哈，魔道至尊？不过是癞蛤蟆跳脚，丑态百出，你现在跪下求饶还来得及！”
一名秃头老和尚也双手合十：“林施主，苦海无边，放下屠刀立地成佛。”
看着这些道貌岸然的伪君子，林云怒火中烧，嘴角却咧开更邪的笑意。
“一群鸡鸣狗盗之辈，单打独斗老子单手捏死你们！”
“老子纵横三千道界，踩你们正道天骄无数，今日便是粉身碎骨，也要拖你们下地狱！”
自己的宗门没了，师尊师姐她们和小师妹也死了，林云也没什么好留恋的了。
本就是穿越而来，潇洒风流这么多年，老子活够了！
说罢，他猛地自爆——轰的一声！
血肉与魔气炸裂，数千名仙宗弟子当场就化作飞灰。
只见血雨洒满黑殿，魔气冲天如黑龙咆哮，天地为之颤栗。
血腥绝望的场面如末世降临。
林老魔的霸道魔威震撼九天，邪气凛然，带着一丝不羁的疯狂。
这也是他最后的绝响。
随着神魂燃尽，林老魔的最后一丝念头也在消散。
可这一切戛然而止。
他睁眼时，发现自己回到了宗门被围攻剿灭的前三天。
魔宗即将被围剿的前夕。
他还活着，魔气未散，记忆如潮水一般涌来，林云有些没有回过神来。

耳边却响起一个破锣般的声音：“叮！宿主林云，系统觉醒失败，延迟八千年！”

〖I don’t have three views. The ratings have just come out. I am possessed by a thief. Prepare your own nutrition express! 〗

There are three thousand realms in the lower realm.
The deepest part of the Demon Realm of Tianyuan Realm.
The majestic black palace of the Yin Yang Holy Sect has been completely surrounded by Haoran disciples of the Nine Immortal Sects.
The golden demon-slaying flying swords poured down like a torrential rain, and the sword light was airtight.
The magic of destroying magic is like thunder tearing through the void.
The blood-red demonic energy intertwined with the holy white light, like the final dance before the end of the world.
Under him, the broken limbs and corpses of countless Demon Sect disciples littered the field, like a purgatory on earth.
Even his junior sister and master, who loved him most, have passed away.
Lin Yun stood at the top of the sect's highest tower, with demonic aura surging into the sky, his black and gold robes rustling, and his long black hair flying wildly.
There was a sneer on his evil face.
The eyes as deep as the abyss burned with unwilling flames, and the demonic aura was as compelling as ink staining the sky.
After fighting to this point, he knew that he had lost!
Total loss!
But how could he just give up?
"Immortal dog thief, if you dare to destroy my demon sect, I will drag you to be buried with you today!"
He laughed wildly, the demonic energy erupted like a tidal wave, and black flames rose around him, like a demon god coming to the world.
The strong men of the Nine Immortal Sects all changed their expressions, "Everyone, be careful, this Old Demon Lin is going to fight for his life!"
But an elder of the Immortal Sect in white snorted coldly: "Old Demon Lin, you still dare to be so arrogant? You are just a little bastard trying to survive!"
"I, the Holy Lord Zixiao, will crush you to ashes today!"
Another purple-robed Taoist priest laughed loudly: "Haha, the Supreme Demonic Dao? It's just a toad jumping around. It's full of ugliness. It's too late for you to kneel down and beg for mercy now!"
A bald old monk also clasped his hands and said, "Almsgiver Lin, the sea of suffering is boundless. He put down his butcher knife and became a Buddha immediately."
Looking at these sanctimonious hypocrites, Lin Yun was filled with anger, but an even more sinister smile appeared on his lips.
"A bunch of roosters, dogs, and thieves. If you fight alone, I will crush you to death with one hand!"
"I have traversed three thousand realms and trampled on countless of your righteous disciples. Today I will drag you to hell even if my body is shattered to pieces!"
His sect was gone, and his master, senior sister, and junior sister were also dead, so Lin Yun had nothing to miss.
I came from time travel and have been carefree and romantic for so many years. I have had enough!
After saying that, he suddenly blew himself up - with a bang!
Flesh, flesh and demonic energy exploded, and thousands of Immortal Sect disciples were turned into ashes on the spot.
I saw blood raining all over the black palace, demonic energy rising to the sky like a black dragon roaring, and the heaven and earth trembling.
The bloody and desperate scene is like the end of the world.
The domineering demonic power of Old Demon Lin shocked the whole world, with a sinister aura and a hint of unbridled madness.
This was also his last breath.
As his soul burned out, Lin Lao Mo's last thoughts also dissipated.
But it all came to an abrupt end.
When he opened his eyes, he found that he had returned to the three days before the sect was besieged and annihilated.
The eve of the Demon Sect's upcoming encirclement and suppression.
He was still alive, and the demonic aura had not dissipated. Memories came flooding back like a tide, and Lin Yun was somewhat unable to recover.
But a voice like a broken gong sounded in his ears: "Ding! Host Lin Yun, the system awakening failed, delayed for eight thousand years!"
